description: The full reverse-engineered blueprint of one video: hook frame by frame, beat sheet with timestamps, shot list, style guide, voice and sound, script template, production plan, edit recipe, QA checklist, plus a runnable recipe prompt. Markdown by default; format "json" returns the plates, toolkit, recipe and measured timeline as one object. To see the film's frames, call get_frames. Accepts a REF id (REF-0005), a refs.video link, the source YouTube/X link, or the id from search_videos. Needs a Refs account with Pro; without one, the app asks the user to sign in. search_videos is free.

format.description: Default markdown. "json": plates as an array, the toolkit, the measured timeline (shots, camera, type, audio grid) and the frame sheets on hand

id.description: REF-0005, a refs.video/v/… link, a YouTube/X link, an id from search_videos, or one of your brand films (brand:<import>:<film>, from get_brand)

name: get_blueprint
title: Get a video's blueprint
